overview: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit to convert two commercial units to residential apartments on High Street and approved meeting minutes. Hearings for residential variance requests on Broadway, Bailey Street, and South Street were continued to the October meeting.

items.title: 595 Broadway
items.summary: Continued to October 27 at the applicant's request to allow time to finalize updated plans and zoning analysis tables.

items.title: 0 Bailey Street
items.summary: Continued to the next meeting to allow the applicant to submit a legal memorandum addressing hardship criteria and questions regarding site access and drainage.

items.title: 20-22 High Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit to convert two second-floor commercial units into residential apartments with a parking requirement waiver.

items.title: 54 South Street
items.summary: Continued to the next regular meeting after board members and abutters raised concerns regarding the proposed four-unit addition classification, carriage house demolition, and drainage impacts.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the August meeting minutes with minor corrections.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Voted to enter executive session to discuss litigation strategy in Sidney Wolfe, Trustee v. City of Medford Zoning Board of Appeals regarding 4060 Mystic Valley Parkway.
